name: Device Key Rotation
description: Rotate device keys on a schedule or on compromise. Old keys are revoked with receipts. Rotation preserves continuity of device-bound sessions and capabilities.
purpose: Limit the blast radius of key compromise while maintaining device identity continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Key rotation flow defined: generate new key pair, sign with old key, submit to server for attestation
Old key revocation receipt produced and stored
Session continuity during rotation — existing session tokens re-signed with new key
Scheduled rotation interval configurable per device policy
Emergency rotation on compromise: immediate revocation of old key, all device sessions re-issued
Rotation audit trail: every rotation event is receipted with old key fingerprint, new key fingerprint, and reason
